description: Baseline capability for the main shell window only (D01). core:default covers invoke, events and basic window reads; core:tray:default prepares the tray (D08); the core:window:allow-* list covers window lifecycle for the multi-window manager (D05) and set-fullscreen for kiosk (D12). Remote pages get ZERO capabilities until D04 scopes remote IPC to the persea origin. Phase C pre-wiring (dispatcher, 2026-08-13): opener + clipboard-manager permissions for the shell pages.
